question: Can a 28-feature LOO-cross-validated regression model predict ω-magnitude within s005's 3-5% basin radius?
hypothesis: An LC-feature regression (linear/ridge/RF/GB) can predict ω-mag accurately enough to seed LM polish.
narrative_md: Decisive negative. A 28-feature LOO-CV regression (linear/ridge/RF/GB x {direct ω, log ω}) on 100 m048 truth LCs cannot predict ω-magnitude within s005's 3-5% basin radius: best model (GB on log target) median LOO MAPE 16.4%, worse than s007's truth-aware oracle ceiling (7.4%) and far above the 3% bar. Confirms s007 — naive LC-feature → ω priors hit the multi-periodicity wall and are structurally dead for the ω-prior class.
